CALCULATION (step by step)
----------------------------------------------------------------------

 2. Collision type: identical nonce  — also the fingerprint of an RFC6979 HMAC-DRBG collision.
 3. PIN k from a same-key collision, verified by x(k·G) mod n == r:
 4.     k = (z_i - z_j)/(s_i - s_j)     (mod n)
 5.     k = 0x000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000000…
 6. Then recover each key that signed under this R:
 7.     x = (s·k - z)/r      (mod n)
 8.     x = 0xc7d7f8d7bf45cb9608225b9c97d2a960d7186394d4ebd754…
 9. VERIFIED: x·G matches this input's on-chain public key.
10. This nonce was shared by 28 distinct keys — each is recovered independently (cross-wallet leak).
